placements.why: Establishes a new organizational category for managing ferry transit timetables, route adjustments, and schedule operations.
placements.title: Ferry schedule adjustments and route operations management
placements.frame: How should ferry timetables, sailing frequencies, and operational capacity adapt to passenger demand patterns?

placements.why: Unifies the advance of the final weekday sailing due to sub-ten passenger counts with the decision to keep weekend late sailings intact because they continue to fill.
placements.title: Curtailing underutilized weekday late sailings while preserving full-capacity weekend service
placements.frame: How should late-night ferry sailings balance weekday ridership retrenchment against sustained weekend demand?
